verdict.rationale: SES offers a free tier for new customers of up to 3,000 message charges per month for the first 12 months, followed by pay-as-you-go pricing with no upfront commitment. The catch is that new accounts start in a sandbox that can only send to verified identities. A founder must request production access before mail can reach arbitrary real users, so the default trial is effectively test-only. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the free-tier allowance applies after production access is granted, documentation of the production-access approval process and timeline, a free allowance that is not limited to 12 months, and independent or hands-on corroboration of founders sending real mail to users on the free tier.
